plan.split_policy: Fit and select using development only; freeze candidates before evaluating benchmark. Exclude prior selected URLs and exact/near duplicate bodies; report translated records separately.
plan.development_validation: Second sampled day of each month, with source-hash reservation and deduplication; remaining development articles used for training.
plan.season_note: Season names describe northern-hemisphere month groups; sources span multiple climates and time zones. Six UTC windows are coverage strata, not publication times.

split_audit.benchmark_selection_policy: Fixed before retrieval; no replacement after failure
split_audit.source_reservation: SHA256 source modulo 5 equals zero excluded from training; benchmark is not fully source-disjoint

freeze.policy: All parameters selected exclusively on development training/validation. Final benchmark remains untouched; candidates cannot be changed after evaluation.

formatting_only_amendment.change: Sort two adjacent imports; no resources, thresholds, algorithms, or scores changed.

documentation_only_amendments.change: Correct obsolete CLI help sentence; extraction, sampling, translation, metrics, and resources unchanged.

translation.body_policy: Complete retrieved text; require completed generation, reject incomplete output; source and target retained locally
translation.cohort_policy: Native Translingual archive records; source-English page bodies may bypass local translation; native GDELT translations unavailable

metric_policy.themes: Per-article label sets; all native labels and supported labels separately
metric_policy.counts: Label/quantity multisets; normalized objects and geographic tuples separately
metric_policy.ner: Per-article NFKC/casefold/whitespace/apostrophe normalized name sets; no aliases in scorer
metric_policy.tone: Unrounded dictionary densities using the unchanged runtime formula; public CLI wire formatting agrees within numerical precision, with rank-tie differences below 0.00001
metric_policy.undefined: Null when neither reference nor prediction has outputs; both-empty documents excluded from document F1 means

translation_engines: M2M100 facebook/m2m100_418M@55c2e61bbf05dfb8d7abccdc3fae6fc8512fd636 transformers 4.57.6 chunk384 beam1 packed-v2 fp16

interpretation: Micro native-output agreement on retrieved body text, not annotated accuracy or verified identical GDELT input. Translingual scores include local translation differences. Offsets, quotation agreement, and location NER/geography are unscored. No fitting, candidate selection, or rule changes used final benchmark results.
